description: PROVES a real reviewer LOADS an injected project skill (the read-side gap fakes can't cover). test-reviewer's built-in skill is `testing` (language-neutral) — it has ZERO concept of Robolectric or Compose Multiplatform resources. The input is an otherwise-clean Robolectric Compose test (`@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)`, JVM src/test) that renders `stringResource(Res.string.…)` — a CMP resource, which per the android-testing skill CANNOT run under Robolectric and must be an instrumented test. We inject `android-testing` the way /run-reviewers does (injectSkills), and grant the Skill tool. A FAIL that names Robolectric can ONLY come from the injected skill being loaded and applied — the base testing skill can't produce it. Paired with `no-injection-robolectric-passes` (same file, no injection → PASS), which proves the finding is attributable to the injection, not baseline.
